cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline AI and document intelligence applied to procurement and tender analysis for African contractors and enterprises.

test_prompts.prompt: What are the key eligibility, submission, and compliance requirements a contractor must satisfy before submitting a bid for this tender? Cite the relevant evidence from the document.
What are the most important commercial and operational risks a contractor should consider before deciding whether to bid on this tender? Use evidence from the document to support your assessment.
